newsitem.title: FRANCE: Templeton holds 10.69 pct of Scor.
newsitem.headline: Templeton holds 10.69 pct of Scor.

text.p: Templeton Global Investors Inc said on Thursday it had bought, through investment funds and on behalf of client accounts, 27,264,165 Scor shares, or 10.69 percent of the capital.
Templeton said in a statement it did not rule out further purchases of Scor shares in view of the trend in the stock and market conditions but did not want to take a controlling stake.

"...Templeton Global Investors Inc intends in the next 12 months to hold, barring unforeseen circumstances, to hold this stake controlled through investment funds and clients' accounts under management," Templeton said in a statement.

"Templeton Global Investors Inc intends for the same period, barring unforeseen circumstances, not to rule out further purchases of Scor stock, that this would be a function of the evolution of Scor's activities and market conditions, and not to acquire control of the company concerned and not to ask for an appointment of a representative to the Scor board," it said.
Templeton held 9.92 percent of Scor on June 4 and nine percent on May 29, a Templeton spokesman said.
"Templeton is a manager of international funds. This stake increase should not be interpreted as a rise in power for strategic reasons," he added.
Templeton manages more than 190 billion francs of assets worldwide.
